title: TaL: a synchronised multi-speaker corpus of ultrasound tongue imaging, audio, and lip videos
core_eligible_layer: Manually annotated short-segment boundaries and transcriptions for spontaneous-speech utterances (.lab CSV); linked primary audible speech audio/ultrasound/lip video
excluded_or_review_layer: Silent-speech productions are outside non-singing spoken-production core unless separately useful as articulatory-only production; no claim that other boundaries are manual
variety: native English; speaker ID encodes country of origin
manual_annotation_scope: Spontaneous utterances up to ~60 s were manually subdivided into typically 5-10 s segments; .lab supplies start/end seconds and transcription
primary_modalities: WAV audio; ULT/PARAM ultrasound; MP4 lip video; SYNC hardware synchronization; prompt TXT
task_types: audible read speech; spontaneous speech; whispered speech (TaL1); calibration; also silent speech and swallow objects
lineage_notes: TaL1 and TaL80 are independent datasets. Shared prompts overlap across datasets; do not deduplicate productions merely because prompt text repeats. samples/ is a subset/representation of core and must not inflate recording counts.
counts_notes: TaL1: 1 speaker across 6 sessions, core ~49 GB; TaL80: 81 speakers one session each, core ~498 GB. Manual .lab row counts not yet enumerated.
pending: Enumerate .lab files/rows via rsync; ingest every manual segment; inventory participant docs and prompt metadata; link each segment to recording lineage and synchronized modalities; exclude duplicate samples/ representations
